Retrieve CDISC Controlled Terminology

Source: R/get_ct.R
get_ct.Rd

Convenience wrapper around get_dataset for CT data.

Usage

get_ct(type = c("sdtm", "adam"), version = NULL)

Arguments

type

One of "sdtm" or "adam".

version

CT version date string e.g. "2024-09-27". NULL returns the latest available version.

Value

A data frame of CT terms valid at the requested version.

Examples

ct <- get_ct("sdtm")
head(ct)
